probes.input: Replay the depth-first route on base and head.
probes.observe: Mean luminance and saturation per capture; a uniform shift across every capture names an output color change, a shift only on model pixels names a texture color change.

source.note: Lightness separates hero, floor and background before hue.

probes.input: Press the move keys, then wait the same time with no input; the region that changes is the hero box.
probes.observe: Mean grayscale lightness of the hero box against its surroundings, base versus head.

source.note: The moving region is taken as the hero box; no threshold is set.

probes.input: Round each head capture pixel to the nearest base-capture color in OKLab.
probes.observe: Share of pixels far from every base color.

source.note: Distance in OKLab to the build palette; observed as a distribution.

probes.input: Capture a lit object with the default rig.
probes.observe: Lightness on the lit and the far side; the far side must stay above zero and the gap must survive the upgrade.

source.note: Render a grey sphere; lit and far sides must differ and the far side is not zero.

probes.input: Frame an object over flat ground.
probes.observe: Stripes on the floor (acne) and a gap between object and shadow (peter panning).

source.note: No stripes on the floor and the shadow stays attached.

probes.input: Move the camera slowly across consecutive frames.
probes.observe: Shadow edges jumping between consecutive captures.

source.note: Cascade splits recomputed per frame make shadow edges shimmer.

probes.input: Load every scene the game opens.
probes.observe: Every requested asset path returns 200 on head as on base; list new 404s and decode errors.

source.note: Every asset path the scene file requests exists and loads.

probes.input: Run the Khronos glTF Validator over every .glb and .gltf the game ships.
probes.observe: Validator errors; an error blocks the PR.

source.note: Pass every exported .glb through glTF Validator before upload.

probes.input: Capture a character mid-animation at a fixed step on base and head.
probes.observe: Bones in the same pose; feet do not slide, joints do not fold.

source.note: AnimationMixer plays clips; bone names map between skeletons.

probes.input: Replay the route with KeyboardEvent.code kept and key replaced by the Korean two-set jamo on the same physical key.
probes.observe: The game still moves exactly as with the US layout.

source.note: keyboard-layout measures whether the build moves under Korean-layout key values.

probes.input: Lock the pointer, then press Escape.
probes.observe: The game pauses and shows a prompt to lock again.

source.note: After ESC releases the lock the game stops and shows the relock prompt.

probes.input: Emulate a phone and drag the virtual stick or the canvas.
probes.observe: The drag direction reaches the game state and moves the camera or hero.

source.note: Dragging the stick under device emulation must enter the game input.

probes.input: Connect a gamepad with axes inside the dead zone and give no input.
probes.observe: Movement input stays zero.

source.note: Idle axes inside the threshold give zero movement.

probes.input: Plant a gamepad disconnect event mid-play.
probes.observe: The run pauses and a notice appears.

source.note: A planted disconnect stops the run and shows a notice.

probes.input: Press, double-press and hold each bound key, and press two bound keys at once.
probes.observe: No trigger masks another and each produces its own action.

source.note: Two triggers on one input must not mask each other.

probes.input: Load, then play the scripted route.
probes.observe: At least one AudioContext, resumed after the first gesture, zero blocked media elements.

source.note: audio.contexts >= 1, audio.resumed true after play, audio.blockedMedia 0.

probes.input: Hide the page mid-play, then show it and press a key.
probes.observe: Sustained sources stop while hidden and run again on the next input.

source.note: Hide and return; sources pause, then resume to running on the next input.

probes.input: Press mute, then reload.
probes.observe: Master gain is zero and mute survives the reload as a saved setting.

source.note: Mute sets master gain to zero and persists through reload.

probes.input: Leave stacked or resting bodies with no input.
probes.observe: Velocities go to zero and bodies sleep on head as on base.

source.note: Stacked bodies left alone reach zero velocity and sleep.

probes.input: Replay the same route with requestAnimationFrame throttled to 30 Hz and raised to 144 Hz.
probes.observe: The end state matches the 60 Hz run; a mismatch means the step follows frame time.

source.note: The simulation runs at a fixed step; rendering only reads state.

probes.input: Replay the route twice with the same seed on head.
probes.observe: Event logs and captures are identical; a difference means unseeded randomness entered.

source.note: Two runs with one seed give byte-identical event logs.

probes.input: Play until something saves, then reload.
probes.observe: The saved value comes back; a save failure shows on screen.

source.note: Save, reload and read the same value; failures are visible.

probes.input: Seed localStorage with a save written by the base build, then open head.
probes.observe: Head reads it into an in-range state and every saved JSON carries an integer version.

source.note: Old-version samples must load into an in-range state.

probes.input: Make localStorage throw (quota or private mode) and play.
probes.observe: The game keeps running and shows that saving failed.

source.note: A save failure surfaces on screen.

probes.input: Block every host outside the game folder and play.
probes.observe: The game still loads and plays; list each outside host it needed.

source.note: Reliability: availability, fault tolerance, recovery, login, download, network.

probes.input: Replay the same route on SwiftShader and on a GPU or a second browser.
probes.observe: Same verdict on both; a split names a float or precision dependency.

source.note: The same input record hashes the same per step across browsers and devices.

probes.input: For multiplayer games, replay one input record on two clients with latency and 2% loss.
probes.observe: Non-authority clients do not solve constraints on their own and stay within the interpolation buffer.

source.note: Two clients with latency and 2% loss stay within the interpolation buffer of the authority.

probes.input: Open the game with WebGL 2 disabled.
probes.observe: The game either runs on its fallback or shows a clear message; never a blank canvas.

source.note: Materials compile and draw one frame without errors.

probes.input: Open the game at 320, 390, 430, 768, 1024, 1440 and 1920 px wide at 640 and 900 px tall.
probes.observe: No horizontal overflow and no empty stage (luminance variance under 25).

source.note: The widths gate opens seven widths at two heights and catches overflow and an empty stage.

probes.input: Emulate device pixel ratios 2 and 3 and shrink the viewport height by an address bar.
probes.observe: The largest canvas backing width over its on-screen width equals the ratio (or its cap) and the canvas stays inside the viewport.

source.note: Canvas backing to CSS ratio equals devicePixelRatio; the canvas stays inside a shortened viewport.
